description: Use when an agent must see who a Base wallet deals with: counterparties ranked by ERC-20 transfers, earliest inbound sender in the window, wallets the same EOA funder also sent tokens to, tokens moved. Input: address, optional hours (1-24, default 6), limit. Output: JSON counterparties with own labels (contract/EOA, known token, v4 PoolManager), first funder, shared funder. ERC-20 only, no native ETH. Example: ?address=0x92256Af59E7B98f9f25e445A869b1170DE476c26 Price: $0.01 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

hours.description: Look-back in hours (default 6, max 24; 1800 blocks per hour)

name: base_wallet_related
title: Base wallet relations: counterparties, first funder in window, shared-funder hints, contract/EOA labels
